Class SocketServerProxy

java.lang.Object
it.polimi.ingsw.network.socket.client.SocketServerProxy
All Implemented Interfaces:
GameServerProxy
public class SocketServerProxy extends Object implements GameServerProxy
Client-side proxy that implements GameServerProxy over a TCP socket. Each method call translates into a JSON NetworkMessage written to the server's input stream (newline-delimited). Also exposes ping() and pong() used by the heartbeat manager.
